nodes.lad.options.[most].text.t: Have you heard about the Bridge on the Grey?

nodes.lad.options.[ranni].text.t: Did the wagons with the wounded from the battlefield get through?

nodes.lad.options.[studnia].text.t: Have you heard about the well outside Skjeldowo?

nodes.lad.options.[wojna].text.t: How are people bearing the war?

nodes.lad.text.t: The boatswain sits on a barrel outside the tavern, cleaning his knife with an unlit pipe. "From the mainland? Then sit, but don't order anything, we've only got yesterday's beer. We're not brewing today, the barley went for powder."

nodes.most.text.t: "The Bridge on the Grey is down, you say? You can hear it here when somebody cuts a single thread, and now the traders on the far bank are shouting on both sides. So be it: fewer bridges, fewer soldiers at the bridge."

nodes.ranni.text.t: "Jarnowians and imperials under one roof? We heard. My sister says it's a miracle. I say it's a bill, only nobody's written it out yet."

nodes.stocznia.text.t: "We build boats nobody wants to buy and mend boats nobody wants mended. Whoever has a helmsman has a future. The rest have a barrel."

nodes.studnia.text.t: "I heard somebody poisoned the well outside Skjeldowo. Folk here talk about it in whispers, because everyone has someone on the other side. Say what you like, poison doesn't ask what uniform you wear."

nodes.wojna.text.t: "Like everyone: one hand on the work, one on the family, one on the cup, because two aren't enough."
